create_reference_page.description: Build a standalone web page that renders an OpenAPI or AsyncAPI document as Scalar's interactive API reference - the same page Scalar's own server integrations serve - ready to upload to any static host, attach to an email or publish from a later step. description: Work with API documentation from a workflow. Scalar is the open-source API documentation platform behind the docs of FastAPI, Hono, NestJS, .NET and thousands of APIs. Fetch any public API document from the Scalar Registry or a public address; list its operations the way its docs do; read one operation in full - parameters, request body, responses, examples and a curl command - or one of its models; save a document as a JSON or YAML file; get a public JSON Schema; share a document as interactive docs for a week; build a standalone API reference page to host anywhere; and send a test request to Scalar's request mirror to see what a workflow really sends. No account or API key required.
